吡非尼酮治疗声门狭窄：博来霉素大鼠模型中局部与全身给药途径的比较

Pirfenidone for Glottic Stenosis: Topical Versus Systemic Routes in a Bleomycin Rat Model.

中文摘要

喉狭窄是一种由伤口愈合失调和胶原过度沉积引起的纤维炎症性疾病，缺乏有效的药物预防手段。吡非尼酮是一种抗纤维化药物。我们在博来霉素诱导的大鼠模型中比较了局部与全身应用吡非尼酮预防声门狭窄的效果。 三十只雄性Wistar大鼠接受内镜下博来霉素诱导的声门和声门下损伤，并随机分为局部吡非尼酮组（每次10 mg；第0、3、7、14天）、全身吡非尼酮组（40 mg/kg/天口服，14天）或未治疗对照组。4周后，采集喉部，由两名盲法观察者进行宏观狭窄分级，并进行半定量（0-3）组织病理学和免疫组织化学评分。组间比较采用Fisher精确检验和Kruskal-Wallis检验。 二十五只动物（对照组n=7；全身组n=9；局部组n=9）完成了研究。五只死亡（对照组3只，每个治疗组各1只；log-rank p=0.386）。宏观狭窄在各组间存在差异（p=0.015），与对照组相比，全身组（p=0.014）和局部组（p=0.010）均减轻，两种途径之间无差异（p=0.531）。将死亡动物归为最差结局的敏感性分析（n=30）得出相同结果（p=0.011）。黏膜下纤维化（p=0.005）和胶原-1（p=0.001）总体存在差异；仅全身组与对照组之间的两两比较显示显著减少。上皮损伤、炎症、TGF-β1、α-SMA和CD4无显著差异。 两种途径均显著减轻宏观声门狭窄，且两者之间无显著差异，而对抗纤维化和胶原-1的影响仅限于全身给药。局部吡非尼酮值得进一步研究。 不适用（基础科学/临床前动物研究）。

英文摘要

Laryngeal stenosis is a fibroinflammatory disease of dysregulated wound healing and excessive collagen deposition lacking effective pharmacological prophylaxis. Pirfenidone is an antifibrotic agent. We compared topical versus systemic pirfenidone for preventing glottic stenosis in a bleomycin-induced rat model. Thirty male Wistar rats underwent endoscopic bleomycin-induced glottic and subglottic injury and were randomized to topical pirfenidone (10 mg per application; Days 0, 3, 7, 14), systemic pirfenidone (40 mg/kg/day orally, 14 days), or untreated control. After 4 weeks, larynges were harvested for macroscopic stenosis grading by two blinded observers and semi-quantitative (0-3) histopathological and immunohistochemical scoring. Groups were compared with Fisher's exact and Kruskal-Wallis tests. Twenty-five animals (control n = 7; systemic n = 9; topical n = 9) completed the study. Five died (3 control, 1 per treated group; log-rank p = 0.386). Macroscopic stenosis differed among groups (p = 0.015), being reduced in systemic (p = 0.014) and topical (p = 0.010) groups versus control, with no difference between routes (p = 0.531). A sensitivity analysis assigning the deaths the worst outcome (n = 30) gave the same result (p = 0.011). Submucosal fibrosis (p = 0.005) and collagen-1 (p = 0.001) differed overall; pairwise reductions were significant only for systemic versus control. Epithelial damage, inflammation, TGF-β1, α-SMA, and CD4 did not differ significantly. Both routes significantly reduced macroscopic glottic stenosis, with no significant difference between them, whereas antifibrotic effects on fibrosis and collagen-1 were confined to systemic administration. Topical pirfenidone warrants further study. N/A (basic science/preclinical animal study).
